applies_to: Carrier AquaEdge 19XR two-stage semi-hermetic centrifugal chillers with PIC 5 controls, software version 3.0.
summary: The PIC 5 controller on the 19XR talks BACnet IP over its Ethernet port once the optional BACnet dongle is fitted and BACnet is enabled in the BACnet Config menu. This software 3.0 manual prints a 455-object table of AVs and BVs named <CCN table>_<point>: status, temperatures, pressures, guide vane and VFD values, surge and hot gas bypass settings, alarms, service settings and paired _rd/_wr command objects.
notes: Instance numbers changed between PIC 5 software versions: the version 3.3 manual (19XR-CLT-3T, our 19xr-pic5 list) prints a shorter 159-object table, and the same instance can hold a different point (e.g. AV 114 here is MAISURGE_dts_act, in 3.3 it is the control point command). Match the list to the software on the chiller.
Commands use paired objects: the _rd copy is read-only status and the _wr copy (RW) is what the BMS writes.

AV 80 is printed twice (VFD Speed Output mA, OUTPUTS_VFD_OUT, and Voltage Umbal Persist, ISM_MCFG_vu_per); only the first is kept here. Two IDs print without a colon (AV231, AV285) and are kept as AV 231 and AV 285.
Tower Fan High Setpoint (AV 319) has no read/write entry and is listed read-only.
Units printed as ^F are shown as Δ°F and ^psig as Δpsi (differences). Coded AVs carry their state texts as printed.

Compressor status codes (Table A): 1 Off, 2 Control Test, 3 Pumpdown, 4 Lockout, 5 Recycle, 6 Tripout, 7 Timeout, 8-9 Prestart, 10 Startup, 11 Autorst, 12 Ramping, 13 Running, 14 Override, 15 Demand Shutdown.

source.title: AquaEdge 19XR Two-Stage High-Efficiency Semi-Hermetic Centrifugal Liquid Chillers with PIC 5 Controls Version 3.0 - Controls Operation and Troubleshooting (Appendix D: BACnet Option, Table C BACnet Point Table)

integration.summary: Fit the BACnet dongle, set BACnet Enable, network number and identifier in the BACnet Config menu, and put the chiller in NETWORK control mode. It then starts and stops from the CHIL_S_S and CHIL_OCC network points (BV 103 and BV 105); write control point and demand limit through the _wr objects and read control mode, chiller state, water temperatures and alarm state.

minimum_points.name: GENUNIT_ctl_mode
minimum_points.why: Control mode: Local, Network, Remote, Local Sched

integration.enable: In NETWORK control mode the chiller is started and stopped by the CHIL_S_S and CHIL_OCC points written over the network; EMSTOP can also shut it down. If the STOP OVERRIDE point in GENUNIT is enabled, the chiller cannot start.
setup: BACnet IP only, through the PIC 5 Ethernet port; the blue BACnet dongle must be plugged into the PIC 5 board (check Inputs Status > BACnet Dongle = Yes).
BACnet Config menu (Advanced User password): BACnet Enable, Metric Unit (default 1), Network (default 1) and Identifier (default 1600001; the leading 16 is Carrier's vendor ID).
Change the network number and identifier when more than one Carrier chiller is on the network; changing them reboots the board after 1 minute.
After changing the IP address in the SETUP menu, reboot or power-cycle the PIC 5 so the BACnet stack is rebuilt.
A router between the chiller and the BMS stops discovery; the manual lists it as a cause of no response.
gotchas: Write the _wr objects; the matching _rd objects only report the value.
Configuration parameters are read-only over BACnet; setpoints are read/write.
Instance numbers differ from the software 3.3 table, so check the controller version before reusing a mapping.
